procs.name: Dark Revelation
procs.tooltip:
|cFF66DDFFLevel 40 Passive|r
Grants all periodic damage and damage dealt a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of |cffffffffGaze of C'Thun|r and generate 5 |cffcfa6ffInsanity|r.

attempt_auras.source: precondition fixture, not the subject: Insanity 500706 is set to 40 stacks before every Hammer of Twilight 806830 cast (which drains 40 Insanity at AscensionCultistAbilities.cpp:88-89); the subject is the +5 Insanity Dark Revelation 300313 adds on proc

procs.proc_spell_source: Proc of 300313 calls Resource(player, Insanity, 5) (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:170-173, AscensionCultist.cpp:201-222), adding 5 stacks of Insanity aura 500706 directly without casting 804209.
procs.handler: aura_ascension_cultist_event: Check case 300313 (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:84) returns dealt && Chance(player, id) (ProcChance 6 in Spell.dbc, rolled via roll_chance_f ignoring spell mods so forced_roll cannot force it); Proc (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:170-173) resets Gaze of C'Thun 500110 and calls Resource(player, Insanity, 5). Trigger: Hammer of Twilight 806830 (level 60 rank, 0 mana, instant, 1500 ms GCD, CasterAuraSpell 680602 set by required_aura_steps, drains 40 Insanity on cast, DmgClass 2 melee hit); each cast starts at 40 Insanity (stack_set 40, stack_per_cast -40) and reads 0 without proc or 5 with proc (events_per_proc 5, aura_stacks event metric, tool ADR 1254). Baseline arm before 300313 is learned must read no event. Sized at 10251 attempts (residual_target 0.001 per pair, min_detectable 4 pts, >= 6834 trials). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 300313: 0 events in 186 logs (passive; positive control 500110 Gaze of C'Thun: 4 casts in 2 logs); coabuildhub spells_master_index.json entry 300313 matches verbatim ('6% chance to reset the cooldown of Gaze of C'Thun and generate 5 Insanity.').

behaviours.observe_source: Bouncing Thoughts 680607 at 40 Insanity (precondition fixture 500706 x40; expire_ms 1000 lets Refresh set 680607 Effect[0] SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to 40 / 20 = 2): Twilight Shieldtoss 572141 (base EffectChainTarget 3, Dreadnought weapon set) hits 3 + 2 = 5 enemies out of 9 dummies within 7.5 yd jump radius (0 in uncast before). Reference search 2026-11-24: coabuildhub 680607 matches verbatim; coa-history has 0 events for 680607.
